    runs-on:

name: Deploy to Production

on:
  release:
    types:
      - published

permissions: {}

jobs:
  deploy:
    environment: production
    # Do not deploy in the main repository, only in user projects
    if: github.repository_owner != 'fastapi'
    runs-on:
      - self-hosted
      - production
